mobbin:74bc6276-56b0-44b9-9a2b-cd8ed27f6.summary: From the event home, the host opens 'Check In Guests', scans a QR, confirms 'Check In', sees success with 'Undo', then finds the guest on the Guest List.
steps: Guest List: Going and Checked In
Guest List Invited with no guests
steal: 'Check In Guests' is the main action on the session home (screen 1), so tagging comes before any recording UI.
After a scan, a panel shows name, email, Going status and Registered time before 'Check In' (screen 3), so the wrong person is not tagged.
'Undo Check In' appears right on the success panel (screen 5), so mistakes can be fixed without leaving the scanner.
A list icon on the scanner (screens 2, 4, 6) falls back to the guest list when QR is not practical.
avoid: An empty Invited tab with only 'No Guests' (screen 8) adds little for sim rooms, so prefer one expected-versus-present split over reply-style tabs.
mobbin:74bc6276-56b0-44b9-9a2b-cd8ed27f6.fit: Recording: QR check-in outside the SRV can label or trigger recording and feed learner names into transcript and Annotation instead of Speaker #N, without face ID.

mobbin:cd3469d9-df14-4fa5-8003-021c7055a.summary: From the guest list with Going and Checked In counts, the host opens a guest card and taps 'Check In'. They see a success message and can 'Undo' with who checked them in.
steps: Guest list with counts and List|Scan
Guest card with Undo and by-whom line
steal: Going, Checked In and Not Checked In counts appear on the list (screen 1), so operators see room readiness at a glance.
A List | Scan switch in the bottom bar (screen 1) keeps the same roster in two input modes without leaving the screen.
Row badges show relative check-in time such as 'Now' or '19 min ago' (screens 1, 3), so who just arrived is clear.
An audit line 'Checked In · By Sam Lee' with 'Undo' (screen 4) supports multi-operator accountability and correction.
avoid: Social bio and referrer details on the guest card (screens 2, 4) are noise for faculty, so keep identity and roster status only.
mobbin:cd3469d9-df14-4fa5-8003-021c7055a.fit: Recording: a per-room roster with List|Scan check-in replaces ad-hoc name entry, and the Checked In set becomes the participant list on the recording.
